correctness.rationale: Definitions and sign convention checked against the primary 2026 full text. The two-branch fixed-discrepancy Fibonacci recursion is valid for every real offset and real beta>0. A count of all length< n prefix thresholds yields polynomially many offset regimes, giving the universal word bound. The explicit (10)^N negative-drift prefix embeds every golden-mean word for beta<1. The endpoint is an exact previously proved special case, with a strict constant comparison. Standalone exact rational finite checker passes; the theorem relies on analytic proof.

value.rationale: An exact constant topological entropy on a full real parameter interval and a strict boundary jump resolve a natural qualitative thermodynamic phase change for history-dependent frequency shifts. The uniform finite-length bound connects the nondeterminism after zero to Fibonacci growth despite unbounded past discrepancies, while the embedding realizes the bound. This controls a global dynamical invariant and is neither a textbook renaming nor a finite computed slice.
